Implemented Linux-only Settings reordering in **`lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart`**:

- When the selected **screen** is **Cassette**, the **Cassette “variant”** control row now renders **immediately below** the **screen** row (in the LOOK section).
- The Cassette variant control was removed from its previous location under the DISPLAY section **only on Linux**, so behavior is preserved without duplication.
- Cassette variant cycling still uses the existing `cassetteVariantMeta` labels + “next variant” save logic.
